answer: Re-attestations are stored in harbor and summit lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the garden graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 435 impostors cost 854 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
